depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble with bottom-left tail
depiction.composition: single outlined speech bubble containing a centered star

ambiguity: Could be mistaken for a generic starred item or bookmark if the speech bubble tail is overlooked at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: rating, review, endorsement, or favorite status

task_intents: rate a recent stay or meal

example_tasks.task: Write a Yelp review for the new ramen spot on 4th
Submit seller feedback on eBay for the vintage camera lens
Write a LinkedIn recommendation for Sarah before Friday
Ask three happy clients for short quotes for the landing page
Draft a Google review for Dr. Patel's dental clinic
Go through saved items from last week
Write an honest Amazon review about the espresso grinder after two months of daily use
Fill out the post-stay satisfaction survey for the boutique hotel in Lisbon before the link expires
Post a detailed review with photos of the repaired patio roof on the roofer's Google page

example_tasks_es: Dejar reseña al anfitrión de Airbnb en Madrid
Escribir una recomendación en LinkedIn para mi excompañera Laura
Valorar el taller mecánico en Google Maps después del cambio de embrague
example_tasks_ru: Написать подробный отзыв с фото на Яндекс Картах про новую кофейню у дома
Оценить доставку дивана в приложении магазина

context_tasks.task: Upload before-and-after photos to the contractor's Yelp page
Send a $10 gift card to customers who completed the feedback form
Export the Q3 NPS survey results to a spreadsheet
Fix the broken layout on the testimonials carousel

near_misses.task: Review the Q4 marketing budget spreadsheet before Tuesday's meeting
Review flashcards for the Spanish vocabulary quiz
Buy a five-star rated waterproof headlamp for camping
Book a four-star hotel near the train station in Milan
Look at the star map before driving out to the desert
Bookmark the tax office portal in Chrome

reasoning: A speech bubble containing a star is the universal visual metaphor for reviews, ratings, testimonials, and starred messages. It fits a common family of everyday tasks—leaving feedback after purchases, trips, or home repairs, managing customer reviews at work, or writing recommendations—and is easily distinguished from both plain chat bubbles and plain stars.
